summary: Argument coding alternates between zero-marked human, animal and plant patients, and l-suffixes for the served participant. This variation does not alone justify separate senses.

I.1a combines ecclesiastical service by assistants and priests, without identifying their precise duties. u darbo di dayroyuṯo at 35/4 describes a monastic way of service; it is not automatically a fixed idiom.
Elapsed seven-year kxudamno at 24/196 contrasts with bounded Preterit xdəmluxli at 24/199 and xdəmlan at 40/31. Infectum also occurs with forty-day and year-long narrative intervals.
The Arabic-derived verb is inflected in I; cognate xədme with xdəmluxli (24/199) is an internal object, not independently a light-verb lexical sense.
No new fixed idiom is established by xdəm plus a descriptive service domain. The inherited Russian editorial question and all existing gloss wording are retained.
All 50 occurrences were checked against Turoyo. Existing gloss and its Russian editorial question are preserved; round 1 already answered that question provisionally with 1a.

Valency alternates between zero-marked people/institutions (xdəmlan u partiyano; xdəmlox ... i dawle), recipient l-suffixes (xudamwolan; xədmili), and l- full phrases (l kul nošo). At Jan 3.17/294 l qašišo ʕAziz follows xdəmle as an expanded agent, not the served participant.
xdəmwa/xdəmwo appears only in new Preterit-wa evidence; habitual household service uses xədmiwo/xudamwolan. Orthographic xud-/xəd-/xod- variants are preserved, without inventing a new stem.

Jan 2.4/556 contrasts humans’ finite service with a mule as xadomo di ʕaskariye. Part act. follows the glossary’s agent-noun convention, but a lexical occupational noun remains possible. The interrupted koxədmi → koxodəm at Jan 3.17/323 cannot establish nonagreement.

Cognate xədme/xadamat and waḏifa are event objects within service, including the team’s already established technical sense. They do not independently require an idiom. No new fixed collocation was established from observations.
Jan English is project machine translation. The precise supplied English is quoted only as documentary accompaniment; all senses were decided from Turoyo.
Confirm the technical subsense's range: should priestly service and assisting at the Messe remain together, and what duties does ʕal iḏe d-u=qašo specify?
What is the function of -li in xodamnoli at 58/23: self-benefactive or a local conjugational extension?
Confirm the contraction and agreement in gxudmalləx (PrS 34/94) and the group suffix -mme in PrS 34/89.
What service does Barṣawmo perform in Jan 1.15/575? The neighboring washing discussion alone does not justify assigning 1a.
In Jan 2.10/2306, does waḏifa name a particular liturgical rite? Wine and duty suggest ritual service, but do not independently identify the Eucharist.
Confirm xadomo as productive Part act. versus a lexical servant noun (Jan 2.4/556), and resolve final -le in u nošo kxudamle with its duration complement.
Does Jan 3.17/338 xdəmle bab bote concern private houses, church buildings or book work? Keep broad I.1 until the service domain is clear.

summary: Vineyards, orchard trees and figs extend the cultivated-land patient already exemplified by gardens; childcare and an ostrich extend familiar human and animal care.
Named-church service, assistants serving ʕal iḏayye, priestly xədme and explicit xadamat ʕitonoye independently support round 1 technical subsense, without equating all duties.
Army, party, state, nation, young people and publishing for the community extend the served participant; ordinary serve/care meaning and argument alternation remain.
